Held GM-level P&L responsibility for an entire car seat business unit at a global juvenile products company, operating at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and commercial performance. Built an independent product development consultancy running alongside senior W2 roles, taking on product strategy engagements across juvenile, outdoor, and engineered consumer goods categories. Early career included engineering management at automotive safety firms, giving this profile a technical foundation in restraint systems and materials science that most product leaders in juvenile goods do not carry.

profiles.summary: Co-founded the renewable development arm of a major integrated utility, then led the greenfield build of one of the largest wind projects in Texas before taking VP development roles at two additional large-scale independent power producers. The market coverage spans ERCOT, CAISO, SPP, and MISO, with a track record of moving projects from site control through interconnection, permitting, and into operation at utility scale.
profiles.key_relationships: ERCOT, CAISO, SPP, MISO interconnection and market operations, Duke Energy renewables development network, NRG Energy project development network, Masdar infrastructure investment ecosystem, Igneo Infrastructure Partners, independent power producer origination and offtake community, PPA counterparty networks across Texas and California utility markets, Energy Renewal Partners
profiles.career_highlights: Co-founded the renewable energy development division of a major U.S. utility and built it into a platform responsible for more than 1,000 MW of wind development, including a single project exceeding 900 MW in South Texas. Led VP-level development at a large independent power producer with a national renewables portfolio before joining one of the largest independent renewable energy companies in the country. Across a career spanning natural gas, wind, and solar, the project teams under this executive's leadership have developed more than $4 billion in greenfield power generation and acquired more than $1 billion in renewables assets. Holds deep fluency in interconnection queue management, power purchase agreement structuring, land acquisition, and permitting across multiple ISO and RTO markets. Spearheaded a ground-up community solar initiative for a nonprofit organization, demonstrating the ability to move a zero-to-one project from concept to commissioned asset outside a corporate development machine.
